name: Dunya Rahim
about:
I’m an Information Science student at the University of Maryland with a passion for using data and technology to build real, useful solutions. My experience ranges from creating responsive websites to analyzing 300k+ SQL records to uncover trends and insights.

I’ve built tools like a Pinterest Engagement CLI for data visualization, a TaskTrackr command-line app, and large SQL projects focused on pattern analysis. Through these projects, I strengthened my skills in Python, SQL, JavaScript, and data processing while learning to design clean, user-friendly outputs.

I enjoy exploring new tech, understanding how products are built, and making data easier to understand. I’m always looking for challenges that help me grow—whether it’s analyzing complex datasets, integrating APIs, or building something from scratch that solves a real problem.

projects.name: Pinterest Engagement CLI
projects.description: Analyzes engagement trends (likes, comments) from CSV using SQLite and Matplotlib.
